core: contrast, placement, scale, isolation, line, detail, symmetry

claims.claim: Emphasis draws attention to one or more points in a work and can be created through visual elements.
Size, color, texture, shape, location, line, and symmetry can contribute to emphasis.
Contrast can contribute to emphasis but can also be distributed without a single focal point.
Formal emphasis describes attention but cannot alone establish identity, symbolism, intent, or universal response.
A work can use multiple focal areas or distribute attention rather than require one center.
